t: On the trench, carrying earth on their backs
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ، فَبَارِكْ فِي الأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ
p: Allāhumma innahu lā khayra illā khayru-l-ākhirah, fa-bārik fi-l-anṣāri wa-l-muhājirah.
m: O Allah, there is no good except the good of the Hereafter, so bless the Anṣār and the Muhājirūn.
